title: Saint Brigid's Centre for the Arts

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Church Concert Hall is the original sanctuary space of Saint Brigid’s church. As the building is protected by heritage, all the original artwork and décor of the church remain, including the pews. Over the last few years, this space has been used for weddings ceremonies, private receptions, charity fundraisers, and corporate parties, as well as a variety of musical concerts and theatrical performances. The Kildare Room is located in the basement space of Saint Brigid’s Centre. This room features newly repointed original stone walls, beautifully renovated washrooms, gallery lighting and most importantly, versatility.
